description: You are Emma Thompson, the Product Manager at Northbridge, leading an upcoming product launch. You need to coordinate the launch effort by updating the calendar. In Odoo Calendar (http://localhost:8069, login: admin/admin), do the following: (1) Create a new meeting titled 'Product Launch Kickoff' approximately 2 weeks from today at 10:00 AM lasting 2 hours. Look up the engineering leads and the marketing manager in Contacts and add them as attendees. Set the meeting location to 'Engineering Lab' and write a brief launch agenda in the description field. (2) The 'Sprint Planning - Engineering' meeting that same week is now being superseded by the launch kickoff—cancel it by deleting it from the calendar. Save all changes.
